items.source: Should by default at least support MethodInterceptor, MethodBeforeAdvice, AfterReturningAdvice, ThrowsAdvice.
items.translation: 应该默认至少支持 MethodInterceptor, MethodBeforeAdvice, AfterReturningAdvice, ThrowsAdvice。

items.source: Don't worry about the pointcut associated with the Advisor, if it is a PointcutAdvisor: just return an interceptor.
items.translation: 无需担心与Advisor关联的切入点，如果它是一个PointcutAdvisor

items.source: This is an SPI interface, not to be implemented by any Spring user.
items.translation: 这是一个 SPI 接口，任何 Spring 用户都不应实现它。

items.source: Register the given AdvisorAdapter. Note that it is not necessary to register adapters for an AOP Alliance Interceptors or Spring Advices: these must be automatically recognized by an AdvisorAdapterRegistry implementation.
items.translation: 注册给定的AdvisorAdapter。请注意，无需为 AOP Alliance 拦截器或 Spring Advice 注册适配器：这些必须由AdvisorAdapterRegistry实现自动识别。

items.source: Register the given AdvisorAdapter.
items.translation: 注册给定的AdvisorAdapter。

items.source: Return an Advisor wrapping the given advice.
items.translation: 返回一个包装给定建议的Advisor。

items.source: UnknownAdviceTypeException - if no registered advisor adapter can wrap the supposed advice
items.translation: UnknownAdviceTypeException - 如果没有注册的顾问适配器可以包装预期的通知

items.source: UnknownAdviceTypeException - if the Advisor type is not understood by any registered AdvisorAdapter
items.translation: UnknownAdviceTypeException - 如果注册的 AdvisorAdapter 无法理解 Advisor 类型。

items.source: advice - an object that should be an advice
items.translation: advice - 应为一个建议对象的对象

items.source: an Advisor wrapping the given advice (never null; if the advice parameter is an Advisor, it is to be returned as-is)
items.translation: 一个包装给定建议的 Advisor（永远不为 `<code>null`；如果建议参数本身就是一个 Advisor，则直接返回该参数）。

items.source: advisor - the Advisor to find an interceptor for
items.translation: advisor - 用于查找拦截器的 Advisor。

items.source: adapter - an AdvisorAdapter that understands particular Advisor or Advice types
items.translation: adapter - 一种能够理解特定 Advisor 或 Advice 类型的 AdvisorAdapter。

items.source: an array of MethodInterceptors to expose this Advisor's behavior
items.translation: 一个用于暴露该 Advisor 行为的 MethodInterceptor 数组

items.source:
Return an array of AOP Alliance MethodInterceptors to allow use of the
given Advisor in an interception-based framework.
items.translation: 返回一个 AOP Alliance MethodInterceptors 数组，以便在基于拦截的框架中使用给定的 Advisor。
